run_sentence_similarity: run a sentence similarity pipeline to compute cosine similarity between a source sentence and a list of sentences
create_sentence_similarity_pipeline: create a SentenceSimilarityPipeline instance that loads a SentenceTransformer model by model ID
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity scores between a source sentence embedding and multiple sentence embeddings
encode_sentences: encode a source sentence and a list of sentences into tensor embeddings using a SentenceTransformer model
review_sentence_similarity_pipeline: review the SentenceSimilarityPipeline class and its cosine similarity computation logic
